title: Usaunny Bonus Time
text: “Nn, nnh… st- stop it… gyaaaahhh aaaahhh”

It seemed Itsuki was being tormented by a nightmare. Trauma from the torture, no doubt. What should be done about this… If I reported this to Father, he'd probably end up sleeping right beside Itsuki. Father always treated those who were weakened like this so gently. Well, Mole and Riska, whom Itsuki cherished so dearly, likely already knew about this and had their own ways of dealing with it. This time, in order to sneak in, I'd subtly steered those two into staying over at Panda's village instead. If Kou came to check on Itsuki's condition right now, he might end up taking him home just like he did with Luna-chan. …Best to handle this quickly. Actually, there had once been a spear meant for dealing with dream-related matters, but… it was too much of a hassle, so I wasn't going to bother. I'd simply inflict an additional status ailment with Sleep Lance X.
“Ngh!? …zzz…”

Itsuki had been groaning through his nightmare, but the moment I drove the Sleep Lance into him, he sank into a sleep so deep he couldn't even dream anymore. Now then, I'd strip off Itsuki's clothes. Couldn't very well conduct an examination otherwise. Being skilled at making garments myself, stripping the clothes off a sleeping Itsuki was child's play, I say. And so I swiftly stripped Itsuki bare — in riska form, of course. Then I laid him face-up and checked his tail. Sure enough, just as it appeared, it had been severed partway through. To tell the truth, Kou had been fretting over this endlessly, so I'd snuck in hoping to see if something could be done about Itsuki's tail.
“Now then, Itsuki… for you, who has learned the truth and repented, here's Bonus Time from usaunny, pyon!”
“I, source of power, usaunny, command it. Decipher the workings of all creation once more, and alter the form of this one.”
“Fore Fairy Morph! Des-pyon!”

With a poof, Itsuki reverted to his original form. This was to confirm what kind of changes would occur when a hero, transformed by Fairy Morph, had a part severed that they didn't originally possess in their human shape, and then changed back. If there turned out to be no particular difference here, that would mean it was unrelated to the transformed body… Thinking such things, I checked the spot where Itsuki's tail would be — his rear — and found that near his tailbone, in a line running toward the hip, the skin was gouged into something resembling a nasty bruise. It seemed safe to conclude that this was the very spot that stretched out into a tail once he became riska. Now then, time for the experiment…

“I, usaunny, command the heavens, command the earth. Sever the natural order, bind it anew, and expel the corruption. Power of the dragon vein — manifest, alongside my own magic and the power of the hero! I, source of power, usaunny, command it. Decipher the workings of all creation once more, and heal this one with the burning power of flame!”
“Liberation Fireheal X, des-pyon!”

And so, with the maximally boosted Liberation Fireheal, I cast healing magic onto the skin where Itsuki's tail ought to be. Little by little, the gouged bruise on his rear filled in with fresh flesh and faded away. An old wound of this degree was well within the reach of high-level recovery magic. Father, too, had once healed a terrible wound with recovery magic, long ago. Naturally, an actual missing limb required a different sort of spell entirely, but in Itsuki's case there was no such issue. This kind of specialized healing was really Father's forte, but I had an aptitude for it as well, so the effect was quite potent.
“Zzz… zzz…”

Itsuki carried on breathing peacefully in his sleep. His complexion seemed, if only slightly, improved. Recovery magic really was convenient. And with the added heat of fire, it was nice and toasty besides — on a snowy mountain, this would restore body temperature even more effectively than Father's recovery magic. Musing on such things, I watched Itsuki's old wound vanish completely. Good, I say. Now then… I shrank the spear down and waved it about like a wand, casting the spell on Itsuki once more.
“I, source of power, usaunny, command it. Decipher the workings of all creation once more, and alter the form of this one.”
“Fore Fairy Morph! Des-pyon!”

With a poof, Itsuki reverted right back into riska form. Oh? Somewhere in my memory, the Itsuki from a previous loop was demanding, “Why did you turn me back into riska again!?” — but I certainly hadn't decided to restore him to his original form here, had I? I had come to see if I could heal him, for Kou's sake, who worried so over Itsuki. Well, I never imagined his tail had actually been severed. Itsuki's companions turned out to be a foolish bunch, quicker to act than I'd expected. Now then, how had the experiment turned out? Checking Itsuki once more, now back in riska form, I found his tail had healed up beautifully. With that, the treatment was complete. All that remained was to dress him and leave this place. Just then, I sensed someone's presence from behind me.
“Who goes there—”
“Des-pyon!”

In a flash, I instinctively charged in with the Sleep Lance to silence whoever it was. I'd carefully concealed myself with the Cloaking Lance — had I been found out anyway? Well, casting so many spells on Itsuki must have let my presence leak through. Either way, having been spotted, I needed to react at once and silence them. Using something like Burst Lance here would be far too dangerous.

With a thud, I drove the spear in and knocked him unconscious, then pulled it back out to find it was none other than Rabbit Guy, in his rabbit demi-human form. Well, well — I never imagined Rabbit Guy would be the one to sniff me out. If it had been Wolf, that might have proven a bit more troublesome. He was, after all, the Claw Hero, and Father had taught him reinforcement methods, making him one of the stronger forces within the camp. If it had been Father who caught me, I'd planned to curry favor and beat a retreat. “I am usaunny, pyon. Pleased to make your acquaintance, pyon” — that was the line I'd intended to use, employing the technique I knew would get Father to pet me. Someday, I'd have Father see me in this very form, pyon.

Now then, back to Rabbit Guy, whom I'd knocked out cold with my Sleep Lance. You'd gotten rather sharp, hadn't you. I supposed this meant a proper sense of self-awareness as one of Father's subordinates was finally taking root.
“Your rabbit reign will only last until I, as usaunny, manage to get close to Father, pyon.”

I felt like the Father inside my head was pointing out what nonsense I was spouting at a sleeping Rabbit Guy, but surely that had to be a mistake. Anyway, what should be done about silencing him? I supposed I'd need to follow up with the Illusion Lance to make him think it had all been a dream, then dump him back in his bed. But Rabbit Guy's build had gotten noticeably larger these days, making him a bit of a hassle to carry. Well, hooking the spear under his jaw or collar and dragging him along seemed like the best option.
“Rah-rah-rah… I saaaw it~~… I thought I heard some sort of noise, and here you were, up to something so interesting.”
“Des-pyon!”
I unleashed my second Sleep Lance charge toward the direction of the voice. But with a poof, my attack sliced clean through empty air.
“Ra— Rafumi!?”
“That was an afterimage. If I hadn't become the Hammer Hero, that would have hit me just now, you know?”

Of all the unfortunate situations, Rafumi had to show up now. Tch… silencing this one was going to be quite the chore. Could Burst Lance finish the job? Actually, I had my doubts whether that attack would have landed even if he hadn't become a hero at all.
“Hmm… I don't know what's gotten into you, but it seems Theodore caught wise to you while you were treating Justice.”
“A- and what of it?”

My crime scene had been witnessed. Now, how should I deal with the fallen Rabbit Guy and Rafumi? Just as I was pondering this, Rafumi slipped underneath the unconscious Rabbit Guy and hoisted him onto his back.
“Hey, what are you doing. You grab his legs too. We'll dump him back in his bed before anyone notices.”
